title: Anchored Hilbert Cube reconnaissance
stop_reason: The single bounded A1-4 attempt, strengthened through exact numerator/denominator height 5000, produced useful family-specific structure but no nondegenerate anchored point, no complete equation-(6) rational-point closure, no coverage/reverse-map theorem, and no new necessary condition for arbitrary anchored cubes. The audited anti-loop contract therefore requires StageA1 to stop rather than subdivide or rotate to unrelated Hilbert-cube families.
firewalls: No family-specific exclusion implies perfect-cuboid nonexistence.
Equation (6) is not universal; A1-3 proves only a one-dimensional anchor boundary inside a full anchored algebraic variety with components of dimension at least two.
Positive rank of the genus-1 quotient does not imply a surviving point through the reconstruction covers.
The height-5000 search is finite evidence only, not a rational-point theorem.
For the local sieve, affine survivors are 0,+/-1 and the projective point infinity must also be allowed; the resulting rational condition is p|a*b*(a^2-b^2).
The local sieve p=3,5,7,23 is family-specific and does not obstruct arbitrary perfect cuboids.
Stage27 and StructureRadar receivers remain unchanged.
No A1-4a/A1-4b continuation and no unrelated Hilbert-cube family rotation after audit unless genuinely new external mathematics changes the exact receiver.
